howToPlay: Use Tick to control space from a safe distance by bombarding enemies with mines. Utilize his Super to force opponents away or finish them off, while managing his health recovery with his gadgets and star powers.
gears: Equip SHIELD for better survivability, THICC HEAD to boost his Super, or DAMAGE to increase his output when health is low.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer a calculated, defensive, and artillery-focused playstyle.
